title: Red Beets Salad
subtitle: A vibrant and healthy salad that's perfect for any occasion.

items: 1 tsp balsamic vinegar (Costco brand is exceptional tasty)

directions: Trim, clean and peel 2 red beets.
Boil for 30 mins, or until tender when pierced with a knife.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped beets, crushed walnuts, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp balsamic vinegar, salt, and dill. Mix well.
